faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Sukma District Rural Horticulture Extension Officer posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Sukma District Rural Horticulture Extension Officer recruitment is 24th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Graduate degree in Agriculture, Horticulture, or Agricultural Engineering to be eligible for the Rural Horticulture Extension Officer position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 35 years. Age relaxation is provided for candidates belonging to reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Rural Horticulture Extension Officer post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 26,490 for the contractual period.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Rural Horticulture Extension Officer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies announced for the Rural Horticulture Extension Officer position in Sukma District.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is strictly offline. Candidates need to send their filled application forms to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Sukma District Rural Horticulture Extension Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection will be based on a merit list comprising 80% of educational qualification marks, experience marks (maximum 5), and 15 marks for the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates (General, OBC, SC, ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. When will the interviews be conducted?
faq.answer: The interview dates are scheduled for 9th September 2026. A list of candidates shortlisted for the interview will be published on 3rd September 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be accessed through the links provided in the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is advisable to download and read the notification thoroughly.
